items.question: Where did Bria Hartley play college basketball?
items.answer: Bria Hartley played at UConn, where she won back-to-back NCAA titles in 2013 and 2014. The Seattle Storm drafted her seventh overall in 2014 and immediately traded her to the Washington Mystics.
